semantics.bone_space: Effect M2 local bones; attachment22 is resolved on the parent model by the client.
semantics.diagnostic_colour: Actual texture/lifetime RGB diagnostic only; runtime must use submitted particle vertices, shader and blend.
semantics.texture_moments: Per-mip BLP reference uses world_scene_builder.decode_blp; optional runtime_reference uses ActorTexture::decode on the most detailed uploaded mip <=64. Both use UNORM moments, no sRGB transform.
semantics.lifecycle: Constant rate/enable tracks do not prove the aura is active. CEffect external retirement disables emitters and allows existing particle tails. Publish only current-frame accepted draws; no TTL.
